Step 3. Consider the Markovian operator \(W_{01360013}\) acting on the Bergman space. By the Markovian decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01360013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through variational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
